versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Start on APIDot" section for quick access to key APIDot links.
- Clarified entry points for exploring models, accessing docs, and finding examples.
- No functional or API changes; documentation and navigation improvements only.
- Removed the "skill-card.md" file.

Initial release of apidot-3d-generation-api skill.

- Provides 3D generation API workflow guidance for APIDot, including text-to-3D, image-to-3D, multi-image-to-3D, and async task handling.
- Focuses on documentation, integration patterns, and security best practices—no executable code or live API calls.
- Includes routing to official APIDot 3D docs, model pages, and example repositories.
- Details recommended usage scenarios, model-specific docs, webhook workflows, and API key handling.
- Lists official APIDot resources for 3D API development and support.
